title: Development-period historical expansion and calendar-regime evidence
objective: Acquire and structurally analyse all four M005 pairs for UTC years 2016-2019, using 2015 as reference evidence, to test historical calendar-pattern persistence and regime change wholly inside the development period.
success_criteria: New acquisition is exactly four M005 pairs for UTC years 2016-2019
Every shard passes the existing RND-0030 cryptographic/content verifier
2015 evidence remains reference-only and 2020-2024 are not acquired
Analysis uses timestamp/gap/hash structure only and emits no price or strategy outcome
The non-authoritative 17:00 New York hypothesis is tested independently by symbol and year
Cross-pair shared missing/unexpected structure is explicit for each year
Cross-year structural signatures identify candidate regime persistence/change without calendar promotion
No synthetic/interpolated candle and no automatic expansion beyond the authorized years
stop_conditions: Any M005 signal, trade or performance calculation
Any validation or reserved-final-test outcome access
Any credential or account identity committed
Any returned candle promoted into documentary calendar authority
Any broker-write, capital, strategy-selection, automatic promotion or automatic merge authority
